server.name: brandforward
server.description: Local pre-publishability tools. Raw frames stay on the workstation. These are the same Python functions the HTTP server calls.

tools.name: track_frames
tools.description: Decode, hash, and measure every frame of the local master. Wordmark coverage is pixel-measured against the brand template.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcript segments with language tags. Fixture until Whisper runs on the node.

tools.name: reason_local
tools.description: Deterministic on-device edit plan from the anonymized proxy. Never touches the network.

tools.name: export_proxy
tools.description: Build the anonymized metadata proxy, the only document that may leave. Fails closed on paths, pixels, or file bytes.

tools.name: verify_proposal
tools.description: Cross-check an edit plan against measured frames, scene geometry, and redaction policy. Verdict is hold or clear.

tools.name: sign_receipt
tools.description: Sign a receipt body with the workstation Ed25519 key. The private key is never a tool argument.
